evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:attestation-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:verification-freshness-smoke
evidence.note: MaterialHash freshness callback keeps attestation fresh across metadata-only changes; attestation smoke and verification-freshness smoke passed.

entries.desc: Legacy evidence without attestation metadata is treated as ordinary evidence unless it explicitly claims CI/human authority.

evidence.note: Legacy evidence without attestation metadata remains compatible and does not produce attestationIssues.

entries.desc: A human reviewer submits only looks-good without checkedClaims or artifact binding; strict validation rejects it as empty attestation.

evidence.note: Strict validation rejects empty human looks-good attestations, empty checkedClaims, unbound CI attestations, and stale CI attestations with detailed attestation diagnostics.

entries.desc: Trusted independent actor/verifier metadata is accepted and rendered as healthy trust diagnostics.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:actor-trust-smoke
evidence.note: Trusted independent producer/verifier actors and differentiated providers are accepted in strict actor trust checks; build and actor-trust smoke passed at commit feaa0f07.

entries.desc: Missing actor metadata on low-risk/light flows remains compatible, while balanced surfaces a warning.

evidence.note: Missing actorTrust metadata remains compatible in light and warns in balanced when requireActorMetadata is enabled.

entries.desc: Suspicious pass patterns are advisory unless the effective profile requires stricter enforcement.

evidence.note: Suspicious always-pass actor patterns warn in balanced and block in strict when actorStats indicate repeated 100 percent pass behavior.

entries.desc: Evidence signed by a revoked actor or by the same actor as producer and verifier is rejected in strict mode.

evidence.note: Strict mode rejects revoked actors, same producer/verifier actor, same run id, and same producer/verifier provider with detailed actor trust diagnostics.

entries.desc: Explicit external_fact evidence with primary-source provenance, fetchedAt, digest/hash, and fresh timestamp passes strict provenance checks.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:fact-provenance-smoke
evidence.note: Strict fact provenance accepts fresh primary-source evidence with sourceUrl/sourceRef, digest, fetchedAt, and checkedClaims; build and fact-provenance smoke passed at commit 967fcced.

entries.desc: Non-external verification evidence is not forced to carry source provenance.

evidence.note: Non-external and local verification evidence remains compatible without forcing source provenance, covered by fact-provenance smoke cases 2 and 3.

entries.desc: Balanced profile warns on secondary-only or soon-expiring provenance without blocking legacy local flows.

evidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:fact-provenance-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:verification-freshness-smoke
evidence.note: Balanced provenance warnings cover secondary-only, stale, expired, soon-expiring, and refresh metadata preservation without blocking legacy/local flows.

entries.desc: An agent asserts an external fact with no source, stale source, secondary-only source, or conflicting source set; strict validation rejects it.

evidence.note: Strict mode rejects unsupported external facts with missing or whitespace source/digest/claims, stale or invalid dates, secondary-only source, and conflicting non-empty sources.
